Commentary.Commentary: This does look a tricky pitch to bat on but 114 looks too small a target to be failed to chase down. Stay tuned for the run chase.

Lakshan Sandakan was the man who made an immediate impact on debut. He struck on his very first ball to get rid of Mosehle and then went on to get three more. The middle order was totally ripped apart with the spinners stifling the batsmen. Farhaan Behardien tried to play a lone hand but could not stay till the end.

The Sri Lankans started well from the word go, with Kulasekara getting rid of Smuts, followed by Udana dismissing de Bruyn. Then there was a bit of a partnership between Heino Kuhn and Mangaliso Mosehle for the third wicket but once the latter departed, it was a procession.

Unbelievable bowling performance from the Lankans. This has come from the attack which was blasted apart just a couple of nights ago. The pitch looks a bit slow and that played right into the hands of the Lankans.

OUT! Caught! South Africa won't bat out their 20 overs. Another slower ball on middle, Phangiso swings hard but does not quite have the strength. The ball goes towards mid-wicket where Asela Gunaratne gets across from long on to his right and takes a good catch with fingers pointing skywards. SOUTH AFRICA HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 113!
Another slower ball, fuller in length outside off, Ngidi waits for the ball to come to him and dabs it towards point for a quick run.
Starts off with a slower ball around middle, Phangiso heaves it towards square leg for a single.
ISURU UDANA will bowl the final over.
A full toss outside off, worked wide of long on for a run. Just 2 runs and a wicket from the over, Kulasekara finishes with figures of 3-0-10-2.
Full and outside off, Lungi works it off the inside half of the bat through square leg and gets a single.
Full and outside off, driven back to the bowler.
LUNGI NGIDI is the last man in. Can the Proteas bat through till the final ball of the 20th over? Still 9 balls left...

OUT! BOWLED! Slightly quicker than the previous one, but this sticks off the surface. Tahir is through his heave to a length ball outside off pretty early and misses. The ball hits the stumps and Kulasekara has his second.
A length ball outside off, Imran slashes hard but misses.
A low full toss outside off, Tahir drives this straight to cover.
NUWAN KULASEKARA to bowl the 19th over.
Outside off, a play and a miss.
A short ball outside off, slashed down to third man for a single.
WIDE. Strange call. A short ball, banged in outside off, too wide to be played at.
Full and outside off, Imran drives this uppishly and the ball lands just short of a diving short extra cover fielder.
A length ball outside off, Tahir looks to run it down to third man but misses.
IMRAN TAHIR walks in at number 10, replacing Behardien.

OUT! Caught behind! Udana strikes on return! A length ball outside off, Behardien slashes hard, going through the off side but the ball just comes in a touch, takes the inside edge and goes through to the keeper! second wicket for Udana and he is pumped up. Massive, massive wicket. This could hurt South Africa a further 20 runs. 130 might have been competitive.
Landed on a length around off, worked through mid-wicket for a hard-run couple.
ISURU UDANA comes on to bowl the 18th over.
The batsman has played it fine down the leg side for a single.
Short and outside off, cut away for one.
Full on middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
On middle and off, flicked through square leg for a run.
Full and outside off, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Full and outside off, Phangiso gets across and paddles it fine for a boundary! 100 UP FOR SOUTH AFRICA!
Full and outside off, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Landed outside off, worked towards short mid-wicket.
Outside off, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
This is wider outside off, driven through the covers for a couple.
Full and outside off, driven straight to short extra cover.
SEEKKUGE PRASANNA comes back on to bowl.
Full and outside off, pushed back to the bowler. That is a good comeback from the bowler after going for boundaries off his first two balls.
Full and outside off, worked straight top square leg.
The off cutter, outside off, Phangiso looks to run it down to third man but is comprehensively beaten. That did not miss the off stump by much.
Full and outside off, pushed towards long on for a single.
FOUR! That is a terrific shot. Dropped short around off, Behardien goes back to pull but the ball stays low. However, he adjusts well and pulls it over mid-wicket for consecutive boundaries!

FOUR! Just what South Africa needed. Some boundaries. Landed outside off, Behardien goes back to cut but gets a thick outside edge which flies through the vacant slip region to the third man fence! The stand moves to 12 from 13 balls.
ASELA GUNARATNE is back on.
Full and wide outside off, Behardien reaches out and drives it towards long off for a run. Excellent figures on debut by Sandakan - 4-0-23-4. The best by a Sri Lankan on T20I debut.
Full and outside off, worked towards widish long on for a single.
Short and outside off, Phangiso looks to cut but gets a bottom edge which goes on the bounce onto the keeper's pads and then deflects away towards point.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Full on middle, dabbed towards long on for a run.
Comes down the track, takes it on the full and pushes this through to long on for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floated outside off, Farhaan smashes this straight to Dhananjaya de Silva at cover who misfields as it is hit pretty hard. The ball goes through to long off and the batsmen take a run.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Short and outside off, spinning away, Behardien mistimes his cut to cover.
SEEKKUGE PRASANNA comes back on to bowl.
AARON PHANGISO walks in at number 9, replacing Phehlukwayo.

OUT! Sandakan has four now! Full on middle, another reverse sweep attempted and Phehlukwayo can only get glove onto it. The ball lobs straight up and Dinesh Chandimal takes a sitter. Phehlukwayo does not even bother to wait for the umpire's finger to go up. 3 runs and 2 wickets from the over, Sandakan's figures read 3-0-18-4!
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
ANDILE PHEHLUKWAYO walks in at number 8, replacing Parnell.

OUT! Caught! Sandakan has his third! tossed up around middle, Parnell makes up his mind pretty early for the reverse sweep and gores through with the shot. But he is cramped for room and he ends up hitting it off the outside edge straight to Angelo Mathews at first slip!
Stays back in his crease and defends.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.
This is wide outside off, Parnell could have left it alone but he chooses to go after it and cuts it to point for a single.
Short leg comes into play now.
WIDE. Oopss... Sandakan bowls this miles outside off, almost outside the pitch, Parnell lets it through.
LAKSHAN SANDAKAN gets a change of ends.

EDGED BUT DROPPED! De Silva almost had a double-wicket over. Landed outside off, Parnell goes back and guides it towards third man but Mathews at first slip anticipates well and dives to his left, stretching out his hand. But unfortunately for him, it pops out. The batsmen take a run.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
Full and outside off, chipped over mid off for a run.
Outside off, Parnell comes forward to drive but misses.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
WAYNE PARNELL walks in at number 7, replacing Miller.

OUT! Caught! Now de Silva strikes on his first ball! Full and outside off, Miller gets down and looks to play the slog sweep but only manages to get an outside edge. The ball goes slowly to Angelo Mathews at first slip and he takes a dolly! Very poor shot from Miller. South Africa are in a mire now.
DHANANJAYA DE SILVA comes on to bowl.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
Flicks this fine for a run.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full and outside off, Miller has an ugly swipe across the line and gets a thick inside edge which goes towards square leg.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single. 12 runs and a wicket from the over, Sandakan has struck twice in two overs now!
FOUR! TONK! Full and outside off, Miller gets down and sweeps it powerfully through square leg for a boundary!
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot for a single.
FARHAAN BEHARDIEN walks in at number 6, replacing Kuhn.

OUT! That is a brilliant piece of stumping! Lovely bowling in the first place. Yet another wrong 'un, outside off, Kuhn leans to defend but the ball spins past his outside edge. Slightly lazy footwork from Kuhn as he lifts the back foot in the air but forgets to put it back in! Chandimal takes his time, keeps his eyes on the ball, collects it cleanly and then whips off the bails. He is immediately sure he has his man and it is referred upstairs. Replays show that even when Kuhn landed his foot back, it was on the line! End of a promising innings.
Is that another wicket? Chandimal is confident that he has Kuhn stumped. Referred upstairs...

FOUR! Superb shot. He has looked the best of the batsmen so far, Heino Kuhn. Comes down the track, picks the wrong 'un, gets right to the pitch of the delivery and lofts it beautifully over the covers for a boundary.
Tossed up on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Landed outside off, angling away, DM looks to steer it away but misses.
The batsman has driven it through mid on for a single.

In the air... but in the gap! Landed around off, David pushed at it. But the ball stopped off the surface and held up. Miller was into the shot too early and pushed at the ball, almost spooning ca catch towards extra cover. But evades the man and takes a single as the ball goes to long off. 50 UP FOR SOUTH AFRICA.
Outside off, whipped through square leg for one.
Pitched outside leg, spinning away, Miller just taps it towards mid-wicket and takes a quick run.
Full and on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Here is ASELA GUNARATNE to bowl now.
Full and outside off, Kuhn gets down and across and paddle scoops it over fine leg for a couple. An impressive first over from Sandakan. Just 5 runs and a wicket.
Drops this short, outside off, punched through the covers for a single to get off the mark.
Another lovely ball. This is a leg spinner, tossed up outside off, Miller looks to sweep but misses. I am not sure whether Sandakan can be picked by the batsman.
WIDE. Short and down the leg side, DM misses out on the pull and Chandimal dives, parrying it to short leg.
Quicker one, seam upright, outside off, David defends watchfully.
Full and down the leg side, Miller misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads through fine leg. Two runs taken, leg byes signalled. That was a wrong 'un too.
DAVID MILLER walks in at number 5, replacing Mosehle.

OUT! A wicket off the very first ball! Mosehle is over the moon. A wrong 'un to start off with, pitched short in length and going away from the batsman. It is so wide outside off that Mosehle can barely reach it but still he goes after it and only manages to get a thick outside edge! Dinesh Chandimal behind snaps a sharp chance and the Proteas are in trouble now!
Here comes the debutant. LAKSHAN SANDAKAN to bowl his chinaman.
Outside off, dabbed to short third man for a run.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
FOUR! Powerful hit. Short and outside off, Kuhn backs away and smashes this over covers for a boundary!
Short and outside off, cut through point for a couple.

SIX! Finally a big hit. Tossed up outside off, Kuhn comes down the track and swings it brilliantly over mid-wicket! This is the final over of the Powerplay and the Proteas will look to capitalize. The stand moves to 20 from 13 balls. Kuhn moves to 12 from 10 balls.
Full on middle, flicked towards square leg for a quick single. Moves to 10 from 8 balls.
SEEKKUGE PRASANNA comes on to bowl now.
Landed outside off, played straight to point.
Outside off, tapped in front of point for a quick single. Another run out chance on offer and this time Mosehle puts in a desperate dive. The throw goes over the stumps.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Fine shot! Short and wide outside off, Mosehle cuts it uppishly over behind and the ball races away. The fielder gets to his right from third man and dives but cannot save the boundary.

DIRECT HIT WOULD HAVE HAD MOSEHLE. A length ball outside off, Kuhn gets across and looks to paddle but mistimes it towards short fine leg. Mosehle calls for the quick single but it is a risky one. Thikshila de Silva gets to the ball quickly and has a shy at the striker's end but misses. Mosehle was a goner.
A terrific yorker outside off, pushed towards mid on.
Change of ends for NUWAN KULASEKARA.
Outside off, pushed straight to point this time.
FOUR! Nicely done. Full and wide outside off, Mosehle leans and drives it over point for a boundary!
Outside off, Mosehle watches it through.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.

TWO OVERTHROWS! Full and outside off, Kuhn pushes this wide of mid off and sets off for a quick single. The fielder gets to the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end and hits the stumps, but then the ball ricochets away towards mid-wicket and the batsmen take two more. The umpire refers the direct hit upstairs for the run out but replays show that Kuhn is well in. So three runs in total.
MANGALISO MOSEHLE walks in at number 4, replacing de Bruyn. David Miller has been held back.

OUT! Udana strikes first ball! What a way to make a comeback. A length ball on the pads, de Bruyn flicks it effortlessly but it is straight down the throat of Dhananjaya de Silva at deep mid-wicket! He did not have to move an inch. Two quick wickets for the Lankans then.
After setting the field and having a long discussion with Kulasekara, Mathews takes him off. ISURU UDANA comes in to bowl now.
Short and outside off, Theunis upper cuts it to third man for a run.
FOUR! Streaky! On a good length outside off, de Bruyn looks to punch it through the off side but gets a thick inside edge which goes past the leg stump and short fine leg!
Landed around off, watchfully defended.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads for a single.
On middle and off, pushed towards mid on.

RUN OUT CHANCE MISSED NOW! Wow. Unbelievable. De Bruyn pushes this towards point and keeps on running for the single. Kuhn is not interested at all and sends him back. But de Bruyn is ball-watching and does not pay attention. Then, he suddenly realizes that his partner has not moved and stops, but now, Kuhn starts to run. Amidst all this, Niroshan Dickwella at point has plenty of time to take aim and have a shy at the striker's end but he misses the stumps!
Outside off, punched through the covers for a run.
THEUNIS DE BRUYN walks in at number 3, replacing Smuts.
Is that a wicket? Sri Lanka believe that Lakshan Sandakan has taken a clean catch. But the umpires want to have it checked.

OUT! Caught! That is a legal catch! Early break for the Lankans. A nothing ball, on a length, down the leg side, Smuts just tickles it round the corner. But it is uppish and straight to Lakshan Sandakan, the debutant, at short fine leg! He comes in and takes a very good catch, inches above the surface. The Lankans celebrate but the umpires refer it upstairs. Replays show that it is a clean catch and Smuts has to go early!
Full on middle, pushed straight to mid on.
A short ball now, pulled towards deep square leg for a single.
Landed outside off, defended by coming forward.
Outside off, played straight to point.
NUWAN KULASEKARA will bowl from the other end.
Full on middle, pushed straight to mid on. Not a bad start from Mathews.
Short and outside off, Smuts mistimes it straight to point this time.
Short and outside off, punched straight to cover.
FOUR! Wrong line, on the pads, Smuts just helps it behind square leg and gets a boundary!
Outside off, a play and a miss.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover.
The players are out in the middle. Heino Kuhn and JJ Smuts are the openers for the Proteas. Angelo Mathews will open the proceedings to Smuts. Here we go...

TOSS - Angelo Mathews calls it wrong. SOUTH AFRICA HAVE WON THE TOSS AND ELECT TO BAT FIRST. They have kept an unchanged XI from the previous game while the Lankans have made a couple of changes. Nuwan Pradeep is injured while Suranga Lakmal has been dropped. Lakshan Sandakan makes his T20I debut while Isuru Udana is the other change.
WEATHER - It is a wonderful afternoon at the Wanderers, but there could be a storm later in the evening. Hopefully, we get a full game without any rain.

It was a thrashing in the first game as South Africa thrashed the Lankans in a 10-over contest. The visitors did not seem to be up for the contest at all and will have to pull up their socks if they have to stay alive in the series. Will they be able to do it? Or will the Proteas seal it here? Hello and a warm welcome to the second T20I of the 3-match series between South Africa and Sri Lanka in Johannesburg.
